written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Economics for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Economics Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #1018, the PDF in source_url. A pick-one row lists the template's choices that have a C-ID number; choices with no C-ID number are in its description, because an option must have one. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): macroeconomics, microeconomics. Calculus is kept apart: UC asks for a year (calculus-year), the template for one course (econ-calculus), and that course can be business calculus. Statistics is Cal State only on this file, because UC doesn't list it as a course expectation for economics. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/economics.json --dry-run
